definition.name: Retail demo · Customers and orders
definition.description: A small fictional USD retail example. 客户、订单、订单明细与商品。 Includes composite identity, native decimal amounts, UTC reporting conventions, enums and explicit relationship cardinality. Constraints describe the intended model; ontology validation does not validate every business row.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A registered customer. A customer may exist before placing an order. Names are labels, not identity keys.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A submitted order belonging to exactly one customer, containing at least one order line. Shopping carts are outside this example.

entities.name: Order line
entities.description: One product and quantity within an order. Identity is the combination of order ID and line number; line numbers are not globally unique.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: A catalog product identified independently of price. Order lines retain their original purchase prices even if the catalog later changes.

properties.name: Customer ID
properties.description: Stable customer identifier.

properties.name: Display name
properties.description: Human-readable name; two customers may share a name.

properties.name: Segment
properties.description: Business class used for aggregate reporting.

properties.name: Region
properties.description: Reporting region assigned to the customer, not a shipping address.

properties.name: Joined at
properties.description: When the customer registration was accepted.
properties.time_definition: UTC instant stored as PostgreSQL timestamptz; explicit reporting timezone required for calendar grouping.

properties.name: Order ID
properties.description: Stable submitted-order identifier.

properties.name: Placed at
properties.description: When the submitted order was accepted, not the payment or shipment time.
properties.time_definition: UTC instant. Example reports use inclusive start and exclusive end: [start_at, end_at).

properties.name: Status
properties.description: Current order status. Only paid orders contribute to the example paid-order amount metric.

properties.name: Currency
properties.description: This dataset uses only USD; currencies must not be summed together without an explicit conversion policy.

properties.name: Gross order amount
properties.description: Sum of original line quantity times unit price. Excludes taxes, shipping, discounts and refunds in this simplified example. It is not cash received or recognized accounting revenue.

properties.name: Order ID
properties.description: First component of the order-line identity.

properties.name: Line number
properties.description: Second identity component; starts at one within each order.

properties.name: Quantity
properties.description: Whole units purchased on this line.

properties.name: Unit price
properties.description: Price captured when the order was submitted. It is not a current catalog price.

properties.name: Line amount
properties.description: Quantity multiplied by the captured unit price; computed by PostgreSQL in the fixture.

properties.name: Product ID
properties.description: Stable product identifier.

properties.name: SKU
properties.description: Unique stock-keeping code in this example.

properties.name: Product name
properties.description: Human-readable catalog name; historical order lines resolve the current catalog label.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Single reporting category.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: Whether this product is currently offered. Historical order lines may reference inactive products.

relations.name: places
relations.description: One customer can place zero or more orders; each order belongs to exactly one customer.

relations.name: contains
relations.description: Each submitted order contains one or more lines; each line belongs to exactly one order.

relations.name: refers to
relations.description: Each line refers to exactly one product. A product can appear in zero or more order lines.
